Comfort or safety function impaired

B010B.title: Camera Washer Actuator B
B010B.description: Fault on camera washer actuator B. Such an actuator is usually a small solenoid valve or a dedicated pump outlet that releases washer fluid to the nozzle of one camera, for example a rear-view, surround-view or driver-assistance camera; the letter only tells which actuator the manufacturer assigned to which camera. When it fails, that lens can no longer be rinsed on demand, and dirt on it can blur the image or make the systems that rely on the camera switch off.

causes.label: Open or shorted actuator wiring, or corroded connector
Blocked or frozen nozzle or supply hose

symptoms: Camera lens is not cleaned when washing is requested
Blurred or obstructed camera image
Message that a camera is blocked or a driver-assistance function is unavailable

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0160.title: In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit

B0162.title: Sun Load Sensor 2 Circuit
